|rulings=* May be played as a response to a just-initiated Interrupt or Utinni Effect, or as a top-level action targeting a Utinni Effect already on table.
* When retargeting [[Elis Helrot]], choose either a new group of characters or a new destination site (not both).
* When choosing a new group of characters for [[Elis Helrot]], may not include any of the original characters.
* When choosing a new group of characters for [[Elis Helrot]], they may be a group at a different origin site.
* May not retarget something that isn't chosen until the result step, such as a card being taken into hand from Reserve Deck by e.g. [[Twi'lek Advisor]].
* In order to relocate an Effect, it must be able to deploy on the new location at the time of playing this Interrupt (but ignore uniqueness rules).
* This only relocates a regular Effect, not other types such as Immediate Effect, Mobile Effect, Utinni Effect, etc.
